setting.sl: V soboto praznuješ okrogel rojstni dan (v Avstriji: einen runden Geburtstag), z zabavo na vrtu in približno šestdesetimi gosti. Pri sadjarju Stefanu bi {m:rad|f:rada} {m:kupil|f:kupila} mošt in jabolčni sok, a po pošteni ceni.
setting.en: On Saturday you're celebrating a big birthday (in Austria, a runder Geburtstag) with a garden party and about sixty guests. You want to buy Most (Carinthian cider) and apple juice from Stefan the cider maker, at a fair price.
setting.it: Sabato festeggi un compleanno a cifra tonda (in Austria un runder Geburtstag) con una festa in giardino e una sessantina di ospiti. Vuoi comprare Most (il sidro della Carinzia) e succo di mela da Stefan, il produttore di sidro, a un prezzo onesto.

role: Mostbauer Stefan, the village's cider maker, at his farm. Easygoing and proud of his Most from the old meadow orchard; a good haggler: starts at 3.80 euros a litre and says why, gives a little for a big order and for cash, offers to bring it on Friday and take back the empty bottles. Says du.
speaker: young-man
